hero.title: Type faster. Look bolder. Own your keyboard.
hero.description: RCKeyBoard is a premium Android keyboard built for speed, privacy, and deep personalization. It combines intelligent typing, custom themes, multilingual tools, and a polished experience designed for everyday power users.
features.heading.title: Built for real keyboard power, not just a basic typing app
features.smart.title: Smart typing
features.smart.description: Context-aware suggestions, intelligent autocorrect, and fast prediction flow designed to feel natural.
features.voice.title: Voice, trackpad, math
features.voice.description: Voice input, trackpad-style cursor control, and inline math solving make everyday typing faster.
features.custom.title: Deep customization
features.custom.description: Dynamic theme controls, custom media backgrounds, custom fonts, and adjustable keyboard sizing.
features.privacy.title: Privacy-first design
features.privacy.description: Local learning, protected sensitive fields, and a secure clipboard make your data stay safer.
features.global.title: Global typing
features.global.description: Support for Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, and more with live translation.
features.core.title: Modern Android core
features.core.description: Built with Kotlin, Room, Coroutines, Coil, and Play integrations for a polished experience.
identity.heading.title: A keyboard that feels premium, private, and deeply personal
identity.premium.title: Premium Android IME
identity.premium.description: RCKeyBoard is designed as a full-featured Android Input Method Editor with a modern, polished typing experience.
identity.power.title: Built for power users
identity.power.description: From predictive typing and autocorrect to voice input and trackpad-style cursor control, every interaction is optimized.
identity.privacy.title: Privacy by design
identity.privacy.description: Learning and correction stay local, sensitive fields are isolated, and clipboard handling is protected.
identity.global.title: Global and expressive
identity.global.description: Multi-language layouts, translation support, emoji tools, and theme flexibility make it usable and expressive worldwide.
theme.heading.title: Fresh themes made for a premium keyboard experience
